title: Twin: Playing an Unknown Game with a Test-Time Digital Twin
abstract: arXiv:2608.14490v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We present a Test-time World-model Inference (Twin) system, in which a frontier coding agent writes an executable world model for completing continual learning tasks, such as ARC-AGI-3 games. Traditional approaches hand-engineer such models, one custom design per task. Each game hides its rules and goal, and our system constructs them from simulation and interaction alone. Its inductive prior over grid games is strong enough to recover the true transitions of the game and the goal on nearly all levels. Replay validation happens in a twin world model. The harness enforces that an action is not made until the program reproduces every previous observed game transition. Each mismatch between a world model prediction and the actual action result becomes a counterexample that is used to repair the world model. translated_title: 双生：通过测试时数字双生玩未知游戏
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种测试时世界模型推理（Twin）系统，其中前沿编码代理编写可执行的世界模型，用于完成持续学习任务，如ARC-AGI-3游戏。传统方法手工设计此类模型，每个任务定制一个设计。每个游戏隐藏其规则和目标，我们的系统仅通过模拟和交互来构建它们。其对网格游戏的归纳先验足够强大，能在几乎所有关卡中恢复游戏的真实转换和目标。回放验证在双生世界模型中进行。框架强制要求，在程序重现所有先前观察到的游戏转换之前，不执行任何动作。世界模型预测与实际动作结果之间的每个不匹配都成为用于修复世界模型的反例。Twin清除了183个关卡中的179个（97.8%），并且在179个关卡中的158个（88.3%）中比人类更高效。该系统推断出...
tldr: 该系统提出了一种测试时世界模型推理方法，通过编码代理自动构建和修复世界模型，在未知游戏中以97.8%的完成率超越人类效率，实现了无需人工设计的持续学习。
en_tdlr: The system proposes a test-time world-model inference approach, where a coding agent automatically builds and repairs world models, achieving a 97.8% completion rate in unknown games and outperforming human efficiency, enabling continual learning without manual design.
